window: entry run-day close; amc exit next open; bmo exit 13:00 ET report day

hp.v1.meaning: evolving Brier minus control Brier on the same names; below 0 means the evolving playbook was better

paired_vs_control_lineage.meaning: evolving Brier minus control Brier on the same names; below 0 means the evolving playbook was better

lineage_note: The lineage row pools every evolving version on purpose: it tests the PROCESS (does self-revision beat a frozen approach on the same names), not any one version. Judge a version only on its own row.

stage_ep_same_names.note: stage E-P's selected calls (panel_pct >= 80) on the names stage H also researched, priced on stage H's window

drift.meaning: evolving Brier minus control Brier on the same names; below 0 means the evolving playbook was better

gate.rule: revise only with >= 30 resolved names over >= 3 run days on the current version; at most 3 ops, each citing >= 3 resolved names; on a drift alarm only revert_to

small_sample_warning: Below about 30 names a version's numbers are noise; below 20 recommendations a hit rate tells almost nothing.
